mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances; foscarnet chelates divalent cations while denosumab inhibits osteoclasts, creating additive risk of severe hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, and hypokalemia.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, and potassium levels closely before and frequently during concurrent use; consider staggering administration and supplementing electrolytes prophylactically.
